summary.text: Tanya Moya, listed by Ballotpedia as Tanya Mirabal Moya, is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 7 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an educator and coach.

paragraphs.text: Mirabal Moya graduated from Belen High School in 1993, earned a B.S. in health and wellness from Purdue Global in 2013, and earned an M.S. in sports management from Liberty University in 2020.
Her career experience includes working as an educator and coach.
